profile.headline: Software Engineer

positions.title: Multi-Skill Engineer - Engineering & Leadership Development Program
positions.description:
Participated in Boeing's Engineering Career Foundation Program (ECFP), a competitive leadership and technical skills development program involving six-month rotations across different stages of the product lifecycle and multiple business units.
___________
Rotation 3: Software Engineer | Boeing Defense Space And Launch
 Jul 2022 - Nov 2022
• Software developer for Mission System Software
___________
Rotation 2: Software Engineer | Autonomy Concept Center
 Jan 2022 - June 2022
• Developed a C++ driver for sensing technologies deployed on UAV
• Added and enhanced ETL features to the UAV backend with python and SQL
___________
Rotation 1: Additive Manufacturing Engineer | 747/767
 Jul 2021 - Dec 2021
• Develop custom software/firmware along with applicable hardware to maintain and modify printers to minimize downtime 
• Design, prototype, and fabricate 3-D printing solutions for manufacturing safety and quality using improvements using Catia

positions.title: Electrical Systems Design Engineer 1 | 777X
positions.description:
•Design and manage the In Flight Entertainment and Passenger Connectivity system throughout the life cycle from requirement definition to electrical schematics to system verification and validation
•Define testing procedures for the integration of complex electrical systems owned between multiple internal and external stakeholders, that validate expected functionality mitigating development risks
•Review supplier technical data submittals to ensure quality and support certification, minimizing downstream issues
•Utilize multiple model-based system engineering tools (Mapper, and PDM) to implement a digital twin for electrical systems

positions.title: Trip Optimizer System Engineer (Early Identification Intern)
positions.description:
● Created an XML generation and parsing tool, using Visual Basic, which handled sixteen different types of messages and used CRC values to guarantee data integrity
● Wrote a validation plan for testing message communications with the customer
● Found a method for compressing (GZip), encrypting (AES-128), and encoding (Base64) kit transfer images for executing the testing and validation plan
●Revised the operator’s manual for Trip Optimizer and created two new manuals to account for PTC

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Intern
positions.description: ● Helped draft and design electrical schematics for seven sewage pump stations, a concrete plant, and a country’s standard drawing set
